title: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro Campaigns in Legal Dispute Before TSE Ahead of 2026 Elections
detail: The campaigns of President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro are already locked in legal disputes before Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) during the pre-electoral period ahead of the October 2026 general elections. The clashes signal an intensifying legal battle between the PT-led government and the Bolsonarista opposition as both sides seek advantage before official campaigning begins.
